notes.title: Patch 2.7: Final Four Bosses & More!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Patch 2.7
Final Four Bosses & More![/b][/h1][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/cf5c15d2e3ca28ab03ad6c65ae14acdd77bc7672.png"][/img]
Final Four Bosses[/h2][p]Multiple players have mentioned concerns with the Final Four Bosses (Jaga, Gamesh, Claye and Lox). I have implemented the following changes to help alleviate those concerns...[/p][h3]
HPs Reduced:[/h3][p]While I still want the fights to remain lengthy challenges, the length of these fights does seem to be a bit much and the lack of visual impact to the HP bar seemed to discourage some players. Their HP has been reduced as below...[/p][p]  -Jaga 50k -> 40k[/p][p]  -Gamesh 50k -> 35k[/p][p]  -Claye 70k -> 50k[/p][p]  -Lox 166k -> 100k[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][p]-Removed a Buff that happened when Jaga and Lox used their Rage Timer skills. It was boosting their HP and that was not intended.[/p][p]-Fixed an issue where Jaga and Lox both gained a PowerUp Animation prior to being able to use their final Rage skills. They should both now be in sync.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance and Manageability:[/h3][p][b]Status Ailments[/b][/p][p]  -Blinding Light's chance of applying Blind has been reduced from 100% to 50%[/p][p]  -Lox's final Stage no longer uses Bio. Uses Magic Missile instead.[/p][p]  -The "Revenge" Counter-Attack rates of Bleed, Poison, and Silence have all been lowered from 100% to 33%.[/p][p]  -Corrupted Blade's rates of Blind, Silence, Bleed, and Poison have all been lowered from 100% to 25%.[/p][p]  -Void Sphere no longer adds Blind. The chance of Silence has been reduced from 50% to 33% and Mana Burn has been added at a 66% chance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]One Hit Kills[/b][/p][p]  -Lokin's Blade and Final Breath insta-kill chances have been reduced from 30% chance to 16% chance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Elemental Change[/b][/p][p]  -During the Final Lox Battle his Elemental attunement changes in each phase. To help players identify this change I have added the following...[/p][p]  -Added dialogue where the heroes identify the shift and advise the player to try new tactics.[/p][p]  -Added an Ice Spell to the 2nd Phase of Lox, renamed Zero Blade to "Absolute Zero".[/p][p][/p][h1]Other Changes[/h1][h3]MP Restoration:[/h3][p]I found that players could often become MP Starved and struggle to regain it. To reduce this issue I am boosting the MP Restoration in the game. [/p][p]  -Defend now restores 33% (up from 25%)[/p][p]  -Ether now restores 50% (up from flat 50 MP)[/p][p]  -Faerie Flower now restores 100% (up from flat 100 MP)[/p][p]  -Blunt Weapons now restore 20% (up from 10%)[/p][p]  -Whips now restore 30% (up from 15%)
[/p][h3]Icons:[/h3][p]  -Added additional color fades on the Item Icons to help clarify their purposes.[/p][p]  -Swapped the Red Border on "Attack Items" with a dark grey. The red made it harder to identify the elements on the Scrolls and Bombs.[/p][h3]
Gear:[/h3][p][b]Ribbon[/b][/p][p]  -The gained Skill "Return" has been renamed "Life" to better identify its purpose.[/p][p]  -Added "Cleanse" to Ribbon as well.[/p][h3]
Maps:[/h3][p][b]Skelvra Refuge[/b][/p][p]  -Made a full pathway to the village to let players find it more easily.[/p][p][b]Plains of Norrin[/b][/p][p]  -Wandering Merchant now sells Ribbons, Bracers, and Grey Glove Relics.
[/p][h3]Bug Fix:[/h3][p]  -Fixed a bug that allowed Items to be targeted on Dead Heroes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 2.6
notes.notes:
[p][b]Patch 2.6
Minor Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Scout[/b][/p][p]-Guild Knives and Dive are now Physical Attacks (instead of a Magic Spell).[/p][p]-Fury is now a Certain Hit rather than a Magical Attack.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Final Fight Reworked[/b][/p][p]-Corrupted Blade nerfed. Damage Reduced, and no longer a guaranteed Critical. This skill was intended as a Debuff Attack, not a 1 hit kill. It was often followed by Lokin's Blade which is intended as a 1 hit kill and that could result in half the team being wiped out instantly.[/p][p]-Various rotations and spells modified. Also lowered the Magic Power for Stage 3. [/p][p]-Confirmed that the fight was still winnable with a very under-leveled Team.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/d8ce48dd534885809d75d772f52a42d5a9c7b667.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 2.5
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/93e23d334b80412b105922e0afa37328b350f722.png"][/img][b]Patch 2.5
[/b][/h1][p][b]Security 
Added some extra Steam Authentication to the main .exe (TheLastChronomancer.exe). 
If Windows/AntiVirus flags it as an issue, you can mark it as Safe.  Please let me know if you experience any abnormalities with this.  

Class and Skill Changes[/b][/p][p][b]Dragoon:[/b] [/p][p]-Windwalker downgraded Evasion Boost from 60% to 50%.[/p][p]-Dragoon now has Aura:Evade (level 25/Chasm) that boosts Evade for the party by 25%. [/p][p]-Dragoon's Spear Toss no longer adds the Expose Debuff. Instead it adds "Vulnerable" which reduces both MDef & Def by 20% for 3 turns. 
[/p][p][b]Templar:[/b][/p][p]-Barrier has been changed. It now applies the Barrier to all heroes, and the HP of the Barrier has been increased from 250 to 500. The MP cost has also increased from 25 to 50MP. And the amount of MDef it increases has been changed from 20% to 50%.
[/p][p][b]Mage:[/b][/p][p]-Syphon now applies a Debuff called "Mana Burn" which will burn the opponent's MP for 3 Turns.
[/p][p][b]Ranger:[/b][/p][p]-Antivenom can now be used Pre-Emptively. It now also cures "Vulnerable" and provides immunity to that and "Poison". It also has an additional minor Heal added to it.

[b]Disruptor:[/b][/p][p]-Lashing Icon upgraded and Slow state effect added.

[b]Others:[/b][/p][p]-Merciless and Stardust have had their damage formulas modified so as to be mitigated better by Magic Defense.
[/p][p]-New Debuffs have been added. ManaBurn (added with Syphon), Vulnerable (applied with Spear Toss), Slow (Added with Uppercut and Lashing).
[/p][p]-Items can now be used Pre-Emptively to add immunity to Debuffs prior to attacks. They also provide immunity to multiple Debuffs...[/p][list][*][p]Antidote: Poison & Vulnerable[/p][/*][*][p]Eye Drops: Blind & Slow[/p][/*][*][p]Siren Potion: Silence & Mana Burn[/p][/*][*][p]Bandage: Bleed & Expose[/p][/*][/list][p]
-Some Relics now provides Immunity to Vulnerable, Slow, Expose, and Mana Burn as well.[/p][p]
[b]Gear:[/b][/p][p]-Bracer(Relic) now grants "Sanctum" which is a Minor HealAll Spell.[/p][p]
-Ribbon(Relic) has been added. It grants "Return" which is a less effective "Life" Spell.[/p][p]
-Added a better description of how Ziegfried's Necklace/Jodar's Blessing works.[/p][p][b]
Player Experience/Maps:[/b][/p][p]-Added a form of a Quest log. Shae gives the team a book called "Parcae" after she visits them in Pentam. It is a Key Item that displays the current Chapter and next objective. I have also added a way to access this via the Main Menu ("Quest"). I will have rolling updates so your Saved Games should update as you make your way to the next objective.
[/p][p]-Brundin Mountains: Added a Guide that will allow the player to bypass this area. As this map can require a fair bit of coordination and timing, I felt it was better to make it optional for the players. 
[/p][p]-Brundin Mountains: Fixed an issue with one segment of the Brundin Mountains which allowed for a clipping issue to occur.
[/p][p]-Added additional "Powerup/Rage" visual animations to some Bosses (Pomeroy, Jaga, and Claye). This will allow players to better identify if a big hit/phase is incoming and adjust their strategies accordingly (Stun/Silence/Defend/Burn the Enemy's remaining HP/etc.) I also changed the battle tactics for Jaga and Claye to be a bit more interesting. (I might do more in a future patch)
[/p][p]-Falconvale: Added a Save Point to allow for use of Tents within the map.
[/p][p]-Added a distinct line of dialogue after Lox is beaten (based on Main Hero chosen)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/fec9c8f1f8f10c913d13c59a3b63a76455833850.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/a59f989e845d5d2fbbc143877de3d804a17a0c65.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 2.3
notes.notes: [p]-Fixed a bug on NewGame+ where Johan wasn't fully healed to start the game.[/p][p]-Updated icons for all of the Armor Types as well as the Relics[/p][p]-Added a "Status" description for each hero that explains what Weapons & Armor Types they can equip. Added an "Update" event to some key map areas so it should update for all players Saved Data after they play for a bit.[/p][p]-The Jaga & Gamesh Chasm fight has been changed/nerfed. This fight was a bit too gimmicky/long, and players might struggle with it after being given a new unfamiliar team. Jaga & Gamesh have both had their DEF and MDEF lowered slightly, as well as a change in their skill rotations. Additionally, Arkh will automatically activate his Desperation Skill at the start of Turn 8 to effectively end the battle. Also fixed their positioning, so if Gamesh is pulled into the Front Row it becomes more visually apparent.[/p][p]-Updated dialogue for the NPCs in the Blackfort Inn (after Ch8 starts)[/p][p]-Added some Icons to the Tutorial Pop-Ups to help the player associate the terms with their commands.[/p][p]-Fixed some shadows at the opening Crystal City scene.[/p][p]-Added some battle scenes at a couple of the Southern Kingdom Bridges[/p][p]-Removed Exp gain for Ilir, Garion + Lores.[/p][p]-Made Lumon'in and Godhand sellable[/p][p]-Can no longer sell Sanai's Necklace[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/6a273c2d10ab2a742db2641b52db6d089c0c77ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535030/17df56e67fe3b2a2d8252e9ed29654a0cc57b24c.png"][/img][/p]
